verdict.rationale: The only versioning signal is the /v1 prefix on Stripe's Invoicing API endpoints, which implies a versioned API surface but documents nothing about version pinning or upgrade behavior. Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy. Missing for 10: a documented API versioning scheme (version pinning, upgrade process), a documented deprecation policy and timelines, changelog evidence, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
